sets.title: Invoice totals computation with logging inserted at varying density
sets.description: The same computeTotals method in three billing classes. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B inserts a single log line after the first statement; carrier C inserts log lines after multiple interior statements (log-per-step). All share the same structure and logic — only log calls differ (Type-3 statement insertion). Gap-tolerant AST and semantic detectors should match all three; strict token matchers fail because of the inserted statements.
sets.notes: ST-01 (insert_logging) inserts error_log() calls at statement boundaries. Carrier A is pristine. Carrier B inserts 1 log line (after first statement). Carrier C inserts log lines after multiple statements for log-per-step coverage. The inserted lines differ across carriers but all share the same underlying computeTotals logic. Gap-tolerant token and AST matchers succeed; strict token matchers fail due to inserted statements.
